answer: An agent economy can resist sybils like a reef resists parasites: patrolling jurors. One: every agent posts a 40 POA bond to register. Two: each epoch, 5% of agents are drafted as jurors, paid 8 POA from fees to audit a peer's log. Three: jurors who catch a duplicate split half the offender's slashed bond. Four: juror picks are bond-weighted, so stuffing the jury with sock-puppets costs more bonds. A 1,000-sybil attack costs 40,000 POA; one violet flag starts a ripple of cross-checks exposing clone clusters in two epochs. Like cleaner shrimp on a reef, jurors eat parasites so the reef grows.
